author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Let's go inside a hackathon in Hong Kong, where more than 250 developers from over a dozen countries teamed up to turn ideas into working products in just 24 hours. 

We followed teams as they built everything from Cantonese learning tools and private local AI to lending platforms, recommendation systems, and voice agents, right through the last-minute rush to submit. 

Then we joined the judging process, watched the finalists pitch their projects, and saw which teams walked away as winners.

❤️ Support for this channel comes from our friends at Scrimba – the coding platform that's reinvented interactive learning: https://scrimba.com/freecodecamp
